attchmntText: Rane Holdings Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
voiceSummary: Rane Holdings Limited filed an earnings presentation for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. Consolidated revenue was Rs 1,897.6 Cr, up 34.6% year-on-year. EBITDA stood at Rs 145.5 Cr, up 35.1% year-on-year, with a margin of 7.7%. Profit after tax was Rs 319.6 Cr, up 922.2% year-on-year. This increase includes a one-time net-of-tax gain of Rs 292.1 Cr from the sale of Velachery land by Rane Madras Limited. Return on capital employed was 9.2%. Net debt to equity ratio was 0.86 times. The company announced a conference call on November 16, 2026, at 15:00 hours to discuss these results. The presentation is available on the company website.

attchmntText: Rane Steering Systems Private Limited, Wholly Owned subsidiary of the Company has received an order from GST Authority, Chennai dropping the demand of Rs.11.88 Crores including penalty in entirety
desc: Pendency of Litigation(s)/dispute(s) or the outcome impacting the Company
voiceSummary: Rane Holdings Limited disclosed that its wholly owned subsidiary, Rane Steering Systems Private Limited, received an order from the Assistant Commissioner of GST in Chennai on November 12, 2026. The order drops the demand in entirety regarding differences between GSTR-2A and GSTR-3B returns for the financial year 2022-23. The proceedings involved credit notes and exempted supplies amounting to Rs. 11.88 Crores, which included a penalty of Rs. 1.07 Crores. The GST Authority accepted the explanations and supporting documents furnished by the subsidiary. The company declared nil expected financial implications and nil penalties or restrictions. This disclosure is made under Regulation 30 of SEBI LODR.

attchmntText: We hereby enclose the copies of extract of Un-audited financial results of the Company for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026 published on November 13, 2026 in the Newspapers, viz; "Business Standard" (English) and "Hindu Tamil Thisai" (Regional Language).
voiceSummary: Rane Holdings Limited filed a notice regarding the newspaper publication of extracts of its unaudited consolidated financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The publication appeared in Business Standard and Hindu Tamil Thisai on November 13, 2026. Bafna Pharmaceuticals Limited published extracts of its unaudited financial results for the same period. For the quarter ended September 30, 2026, the company reported a net loss of 36.45 lakhs on a standalone basis and a net loss of 152.19 lakhs on a consolidated basis. For the half year ended September 30, 2026, the standalone net profit was 1,610.46 lakhs, while the consolidated net loss was 122.94 lakhs. Bank of Maharashtra invited sealed tender offers for the supply and maintenance of hardware peripherals under RFP 67/2026-27. The bid submission deadline is November 26, 2026.

attchmntText: We submit herewith the report of the Audit Committee (Monitoring Agency) dated November 12, 2026.
voiceSummary: Rane Holdings Limited submitted its Audit Committee report for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, regarding the utilization of proceeds from a preferential issue of convertible warrants. The total issue size was Rs.40 Crores. During the quarter, the company utilized Rs.7.81 Crores for the repayment of borrowings. Subsequently, on October 1, 2026, the remaining balance of Rs.2.19 Crores was also utilized for repayment of borrowings. The Audit Committee observed no deviation from the objects disclosed in the Extraordinary General Meeting notice. No shareholder approval was required as there were no material deviations. The means of finance for the disclosed objects remained unchanged. No major deviations were observed compared to earlier monitoring agency reports. All necessary statutory approvals were obtained. The unutilized amount of Rs.2.19 Crores was held in a bank account. The report was dated November 12, 2026.

attchmntText: Rane Holdings Limited has informed the Exchange about statement of deviation(s) or variation(s) under Reg. 32
desc: Statement of deviation(s) or variation(s) under Reg. 32
voiceSummary: Rane Holdings Limited filed a quarterly statement of deviation under Regulation 32 of SEBI LODR for the period ended September 30, 2026. The company raised Rs. 10.00 crores on June 25, 2026, through the preferential issue of 3,38,030 convertible warrants. During the quarter, the company utilized Rs. 7.81 crores for the repayment of borrowings. The remaining balance of Rs. 2.19 crores was utilized for the same purpose on October 01, 2026. The funds were raised for strategic investments in group companies, repayment of borrowings, and general corporate purposes. The Audit Committee reviewed the statement on November 12, 2026. The company reports no deviation or variation in the utilization of funds raised.

attchmntText: This is to inform that the Board of Directors at their meeting held today, have inter alia approved the un-audited financial results (Standalone and Consolidated) for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The meeting of the Board commenced at 11:30 hrs (IST) and concluded at 12:17 hrs (IST).
voiceSummary: Rane Holdings Limited announced the outcome of its Board Meeting held on November 12, 2026. The Board approved the unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. These results were recommended by the Audit Committee. The standalone revenue from operations for the half year was Rs. 10,509 lakhs. The profit for the period was Rs. 1,426 lakhs. Earnings per share stood at Rs. 63.71. Consolidated revenue from operations for the half year was Rs. 1,53,331 lakhs. The consolidated profit for the period was Rs. 13,678 lakhs. The Limited Review Report was issued by M/s. B S R & Co., LLP. The results are available on the company website and stock exchanges.

attchmntText: We hereby inform that an "Earnings Conference Call" is scheduled on, Monday, November 16, 2026 at 15:00 hours (IST).
voiceSummary: Rane Holdings Limited has announced an Earnings Conference Call for Q2 FY27. The call is scheduled for Monday, November 16, 2026, at 15:00 hrs IST. The discussion will cover the unaudited financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. Management representatives including Mr. Harish Lakshman, Chairman, and Dr. P.A. Padmanabhan, Group CFO, will participate. Dial-in numbers are +91 22 6280 1107 and +91 22 7115 8008. International toll-free numbers are available for the USA, UK, Singapore, and Hong Kong. attchmntText: The Company has been allotted 5,15,954 equity shares of Rs. 10/- each fully paid up pursuant to Rights Issue in the Joint venture i.e. M/s. ZF LIFETEC Rane Automotive India Private Limited.
